description: a tall muscular barbarian woman with long red-brown hair in thick braids, the horned skull of a giant beast worn as a helmet with two long curved horns, a thick black fur mantle over the shoulders, a fitted leather and fur top, glowing red war paint runes on her arms, a fur kilt with a wide belt, fur-wrapped boots, no axe, nothing in the hands but the reins, sitting upright and relaxed in the middle of the saddle exactly like the rider of the reference, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the face, chest and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near leg showing and the far leg hidden behind the horse, the near thigh lying forward along the saddle and the lower leg hanging straight down from the knee to the foot, one normal slim leg, never two legs, the far leg completely hidden behind the horse, not squatting, not crouching, the knees never apart, not tucked up, not slanting, both upper arms down along the body and both forearms reaching forward, the two hands close together in front of the body above the horse's neck holding the reins, the same size and place as the reference rider, the whole figure from the top of the horns to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look only: the face, hair, headwear, clothes and colours; not the pose and not the axe

a finished rider of the game which the author accepted: copy exactly how it sits in the middle of the saddle, seen exactly from the side in profile, only the near leg showing, the near thigh forward along the saddle and the lower leg hanging straight down, and how both hands reach forward together to the reins; not its face, clothes or colours
the pose of the figure: sitting sideways, the near thigh forward and the lower leg hanging straight down, only the near leg; not its hood or cloak
